about_the_game:
Then One Day ...- memorist Tales is an action roguelike game that uses a point-and-click control system.

Grow your character by navigating through a mysterious and secretive forest, collecting enemies’ memories along the way.

The unknown and secret forest, Noejead

Due to an unexpected incident, the protagonist flees from the village and heads toward the secret forest of Noejead, which is off-limits due to its dangers.

In the mysterious forest of Noejead, where danger lurks at every corner, the protagonist must overcome approaching threats and journey deeper into Noejead in order to escape from the village.

Memory absorption

Players can absorb the memories of defeated enemies to make themselves stronger.

Defeat enemies and use the memories you gain to take on a variety of foes.

Gather the memories obtained from enemies to enhance your abilities.

Explore the depths of Noejead.

Noejead makes various attempts to capture intruders.

As you explore Noejead, meet new allies, discover treasures, and defeat enemies on your journey to the heart of the forest.

Noejead will offer you a wide range of experiences.

[Demo Content]

In the demo version, you can play from the tutorial up to the Act 1 boss. The full game features 30 types of monsters and 5 bosses, while the demo includes 15 types of monsters and 1 boss. Defeat various monsters and bosses to collect and enhance a variety of memories, and experience diverse combat.
